groups.name: lifecycle
skippedTests: CLI shuts down on POSIX SIGTERM

inputAssessment: All final groups/checks have identical final source/test/config inventories with no changes during or after execution. Complete workspace rebuilt before tests. Bundled source-map source bytes match current source and vendor files. Historical SQL 1..44 and Runner/dependency files are unchanged.
scope: Local development only: actual foundation start/stop, CAS/layout verification, file-backed SQLite Workers, original private command/CAS, HTTP T5 regression and 31-second health expiry. Backend physical fences/Runner custody/health and upstream source/admission/OCI/manual observations remain explicit protocol fixtures. Multi-project concurrency uses an explicit in-process dispatcher over three separate actual Workers. No real model, OIDC, Linux/gVisor, physical preparation/cleanup, automatic T5/publication, full workbench or formal successor preserve/replace acceptance.
reproduction: validation-driver.mjs records the exact full build/type/lint/contracts and consumer/lifecycle/domain test commands, hashes inventories before/after and saves stdout/stderr. binding-driver.mjs verifies selected records, log hashes, final inputs, source maps and historical SQL. Full pnpm check and fixed-commit clean-checkout validation were not run.
actualChecks: Two actual foundation host cases validate default-off behavior, exact policy snapshot, startup rejection/resource release, active-call drain before Worker close and restart inspection without redispatch.
Actual 21 closed preparations precede a new unresolved preparation; the private work page finds the original without terminal-history starvation.
Concurrent tick calls share the same pass; an explicit dispatcher over three actual Workers verifies scope rotation, two-project concurrency and progress after one scan failure.
Original grant/observation ACK loss is injected after the actual private Worker commit. Recovery inspects the original; proof survives and no Release is created.
Real 31.05-second elapsed wait expires current health without any page read refreshing it; the independent periodic backend updates observation while proof and preparation dispatch remain unchanged.
Stop during preflight leaves PREPARED; stop during original execution returns false from final authorization, drains the call and leaves original SENT/UNKNOWN facts.
Actual abort decision and real local HTTP/material-preflight/T5 originals are excluded from work. Consumer does not accept or publish.
limits: Backend physical fences, Runner custody and health facts are explicit protocol fixtures.
No real model, OIDC, Linux/gVisor, physical cleanup or positive successor preservation/replacement acceptance.
The backend interface has no forced cancellation; a non-returning adapter keeps drain pending.
A small scope budget or busy adapter may allow the 30-second health window to expire; final acceptance remains closed.
Caller owns externally constructed backend resources; this consumer owns its timer and drains its calls.
skipped: Existing foundation POSIX SIGTERM case is skipped on Windows by its original test condition; it is not counted as passed.
